hooks.command:
in=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; gofiles=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR -- '*.go' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$gofiles" ]; then exit 0; fi; stamp="$(git rev-parse --git-dir)/go-review-stamp"; hash=$(git diff --cached -- '*.go' | shasum | cut -d' ' -f1); if [ -f "$stamp" ] && [ "$(cat "$stamp")" = "$hash" ]; then exit 0; fi; printf '%s' "$hash" > "$stamp"; reason=$(printf 'These staged Go files have NOT been reviewed yet:
%s

Review them with the installed Go skills BEFORE committing:
1. Invoke the orchestrator skill cc-skills-golang:golang-how-to — it picks the golang-* skills that match these changes (concurrency, error-handling, testing, naming, security, ...).
2. ALWAYS also run the go-review skill on the staged diff (Effective Go + Google Go Style Guide; it cites the rule and file:line).
Fix the findings, or briefly justify each one you leave as is. Then run git commit again — the same staged content is not blocked twice.' "$gofiles"); jq -cn --arg r "$reason" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'

in=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; files=$(git diff-tree --root --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD 2>/dev/null); src=$(printf '%s
' "$files" | grep -E '^(internal|cmd)/'); docs=$(printf '%s
' "$files" | grep -E '^docs/'); if [ -n "$src" ] && [ -z "$docs" ]; then reason=$(printf 'The last commit changed ONLY these code files (no docs/):
%s

Check whether ANY documentation needs updating — NOT just the tool/capability reference. Possible areas of the docs site (docs/src/content/docs/): Guides (guides/), Architecture & Concepts (architecture/), Reference incl. Sandbox/Runtime (reference/), plus the tool/capability data (docs/src/data/tools/ + docs/src/data/capabilities/, rules in docs/CONVENTIONS.md) and the sidebar (docs/astro.config.mjs). Update the affected docs — document ONLY the concrete changes of this commit — OR briefly justify why no docs are needed for exactly these changes.' "$src"); jq -cn --arg r "$reason" '{decision:"block",reason:$r}'; fi
